description: Designs and builds complete web applications, working across frontend interfaces, backend services, databases, and deployment workflows.
beginner_learning_path: Learn HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; build React pages; create Node.js and Express APIs; add SQL data storage; practice Git; deploy a small full-stack project.
prerequisites: Basic programming logic, HTML/CSS fundamentals, JavaScript basics.

description: Builds responsive and accessible user interfaces for web applications, focusing on layout, interaction, and client-side performance.
beginner_learning_path: Master HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; learn React components and state; consume REST APIs; style with Tailwind CSS; practice Git and responsive design.
prerequisites: Basic web concepts and JavaScript fundamentals.

description: Develops server-side application logic, APIs, authentication, data handling, and integration with databases and external services.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Python and SQL; build REST APIs; connect a database; add authentication; use Git; containerize with Docker; deploy on Linux.
prerequisites: Programming fundamentals and basic database concepts.

description: Builds enterprise and web applications using Java, often with Spring-based frameworks, relational databases, and REST APIs.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Java fundamentals and object-oriented programming; study Spring Boot; connect relational databases; build REST APIs; write tests; use Git.
prerequisites: Basic programming and object-oriented concepts.

description: Builds applications, scripts, APIs, and automation tools using Python and commonly used web or data libraries.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Python syntax and data structures; build small scripts; create a Flask or FastAPI service; connect SQL databases; write tests; use Git.
prerequisites: Basic programming and command-line familiarity.

description: Specializes in building interactive web interfaces using React, reusable components, state management, and API integration.
beginner_learning_path: Learn JavaScript and React fundamentals; build component-based UIs; manage state; call REST APIs; add styling; test and deploy.
prerequisites: HTML, CSS, and JavaScript basics.

description: Collects, cleans, analyzes, and visualizes data to help organizations understand trends and make decisions.
beginner_learning_path: Learn SQL and Excel; practice data cleaning; build dashboards in Power BI; use Python with pandas; analyze sample datasets.
prerequisites: Basic statistics and spreadsheet familiarity.

description: Explores data, builds statistical and machine learning models, and communicates insights for predictive and analytical problems.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Python, SQL, and statistics; practice pandas and NumPy; study machine learning with scikit-learn; build end-to-end analysis projects.
prerequisites: Mathematics, statistics, and Python basics.

description: Designs, trains, evaluates, and deploys machine learning models, with attention to data pipelines and production reliability.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Python and data handling; study machine learning algorithms; practice model evaluation; build ML pipelines; learn deployment basics with Docker.
prerequisites: Python, statistics, and basic machine learning concepts.

description: Builds AI-powered applications, including model integration, natural language processing, and intelligent system workflows.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Python and machine learning; study deep learning and NLP; practice with TensorFlow or PyTorch; integrate models into applications.
prerequisites: Python and machine learning fundamentals.

description: Designs, deploys, and maintains cloud infrastructure, focusing on scalability, reliability, automation, and cost awareness.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Linux and networking basics; study AWS core services; practice Docker; automate deployments with CI/CD; build cloud projects.
prerequisites: Operating systems and basic networking concepts.

description: Automates software delivery and infrastructure operations through CI/CD, containers, monitoring, and collaborative engineering practices.
beginner_learning_path: Learn Linux and Git; build CI/CD pipelines; containerize applications with Docker; study cloud basics; automate repetitive tasks with scripts.
prerequisites: Software development and system administration basics.

description: Monitors systems, identifies vulnerabilities, analyzes security events, and helps protect applications and infrastructure.
beginner_learning_path: Learn networking and Linux; study security fundamentals; practice log analysis and vulnerability scanning; build Python automation scripts.
prerequisites: Networking, operating systems, and security basics.

description: Verifies software quality through manual and automated testing, defect reporting, and validation of requirements.
beginner_learning_path: Learn testing concepts and test case design; practice SQL for data validation; automate tests with Python; use Git and CI pipelines.
prerequisites: Basic programming and software development lifecycle knowledge.

description: Builds mobile applications with attention to user experience, device capabilities, APIs, and performance.
beginner_learning_path: Learn JavaScript and React; study mobile UI patterns; integrate REST APIs; manage local data; test across devices.
prerequisites: Programming fundamentals and basic UI concepts.

description: Manages database installation, performance, backups, security, and availability for applications and analytics.
beginner_learning_path: Learn SQL and relational design; practice PostgreSQL administration; study backups and indexing; use Linux and shell scripts.
prerequisites: Database fundamentals and operating system basics.

description: Designs intuitive digital experiences, including research, wireframes, prototypes, and visual interface systems.
beginner_learning_path: Learn design principles and user research; practice wireframing and prototyping in Figma; study HTML and CSS for implementation awareness.
prerequisites: Basic design sense and familiarity with web interfaces.

description: Bridges business needs and technical solutions by analyzing requirements, processes, data, and stakeholder goals.
beginner_learning_path: Learn requirements gathering and process mapping; practice SQL and Excel analysis; build dashboards; study business metrics.
prerequisites: Communication skills and basic data literacy.

description: Designs, configures, and maintains computer networks, ensuring connectivity, performance, and security.
beginner_learning_path: Learn networking fundamentals and protocols; practice Linux and shell commands; study routing and switching; build lab topologies.
prerequisites: Computer networks and operating system basics.

description: Designs, implements, tests, and maintains software systems, collaborating across requirements, architecture, and quality.
beginner_learning_path: Learn programming and data structures; build APIs; use Git; write tests; study Linux and deployment basics; complete full-stack projects.
prerequisites: Basic programming and problem-solving skills.
